_comment: The daily games, in display order. Used by the build (cards, hub, home band), the generators (scripts/games) and the tests. A game appears on the site once its page module content/pages/games/<key>.mjs exists. og is the share image in src/assets/og/. optional: the game's card is hidden on any day it has no puzzle, and games:check doesn't count it. feature: a daily item that isn't a game (the Word of the Day): published and checked like the games, but it has no game card and doesn't count towards the all-games streak.

games.blurb: One everyday word a day, with its meaning and a fact for word games.
